planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.
Create a new free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimension
Create a new value for one of the free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimensions

rules: Use ?number=XXXX to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
Do NOT use other query params — they are not supported.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.

When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting with the GROSS amount (incl VAT). Tripletex auto-generates VAT split and credit posting. If this fails with a balance error, fall back to manual postings for all legs.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.

payload.headline: All 5 checks failed: wrong amount (13200 vs 16500), wrong counter-account, and VAT logic issues
what_went_wrong: Agent used 13,200 NOK (net) instead of 16,500 NOK (gross) for the Forretningslunsj posting — representation VAT is non-deductible so full gross must be expensed.
Counter-account 2840 (corporate card) didn't exist; agent fell back to 1920 (bank) which is incorrect for a Bedriftskort payment — should have searched for correct payable account.
vatType 0 may not be the correct VAT code for non-deductible representation in Tripletex; the system likely expects a specific VAT type ID for 'no deduction' representation expenses.
Agent was confused about whether 13,200 was net or gross — the receipt shows all items at net prices with 25% VAT on top, so Forretningslunsj gross = 13,200 × 1.25 = 16,500.
what_worked: Department 'Salg' was created successfully and linked to the posting.
Account 7350 (Representasjon) was correctly identified as the expense account.
what_to_try_next: Book 16,500 NOK gross (13,200 × 1.25) on account 7350 with the correct non-deductible VAT type — search /ledger/vatType to find the right ID for representation with no VAT deduction.
Search for the correct corporate card payable account by querying /ledger/account with number ranges 2800-2899 or searching by name 'bedriftskort' or 'kredittkort' instead of guessing 2840.
Verify the exact vatType ID required by Tripletex for non-deductible representation expenses before posting, as vatType id=0 may be invalid or map to the wrong treatment.
